hypothesis: A provenance-clean portable quantized Nemotron runtime can reduce LOCAL_SOLO memory/disk/startup/compute enough to create a new ASR Pareto point without sacrificing German streaming quality.
counterhypothesis: The official Q8 NeMo-Speech.cpp path already occupies the best practical CPU frontier; community quantization/runtime changes either degrade German accuracy/partial stability or trade auditability and semantic equivalence for a smaller artifact.
next_discriminator: After T7-ASR-008 dispatch/receipt reconciliation, exact-pin ONE portable derivative first (prefer smcleod INT8 ONNX unless a stronger provenance-clean successor appears), hash every executable/model artifact, then run the identical pinned FLEURS de_de plus non-speech/gate corpus on the same target. Compare WER/CER, false activation, partial stability, paced first-partial/final latency, RTF, peak RSS, model size and startup against official Q8. Promote only a distinct measured Pareto point.
